method: Playwright UI actions, chooser events, file inputs, dispatched DataTransfer drops, DOM/handler inspection; source review

screenshots.title: Form fields: empty
screenshots.observation: Image, video and file fields offer Add buttons. A drop onto the visible image field made no intake call.

screenshots.title: Image field → Image drawer
screenshots.observation: Add image opens this dark side drawer. Upload and selection are another action inside it.

screenshots.title: Image picker: empty folder
screenshots.observation: The picker invites uploads but contains no file input or upload action.

screenshots.title: Image drawer: populated
screenshots.observation: Dropping onto the drawer preview succeeded; metadata and crop actions then appear.

screenshots.title: Rejected image upload
screenshots.observation: Dropping a PDF preserved the prior image. The queue error is clipped and separated from the field.

screenshots.title: File field → File drawer
screenshots.observation: Another contextual drawer, with upload and existing-file selection.

screenshots.title: File library picker
screenshots.observation: Folder-aware file selection has no upload action.

screenshots.title: File uploaded in drawer
screenshots.observation: The PDF arrived through the shared manager and is visible in the drawer.

screenshots.title: Video field → Video drawer
screenshots.observation: Upload/File and External URL tabs introduce another acquisition layout.

screenshots.title: Video library picker
screenshots.observation: Unlike image/file pickers, this offers Upload file and Add from URL.

screenshots.title: Local video upload
screenshots.observation: A system chooser selection delivered a local video to the field.

screenshots.title: Gallery field before upload
screenshots.observation: Four separate buttons. The floating queue obscures part of this low-positioned field; see the close-up below.

screenshots.title: Video dropped onto gallery
screenshots.observation: The main gallery surface routed the video as an image and rejected .mp4.

screenshots.title: Image dropped onto gallery
screenshots.observation: The same gallery surface accepted an image. A video must use its separate upload control.

screenshots.title: Picture ref: empty
screenshots.observation: Clicking this canvas was observed to open the system file chooser directly.

screenshots.title: Default-config upload → folder drawer
screenshots.observation: After selecting a file, the image picker is reused to ask for Upload here.

screenshots.title: Picture ref: populated
screenshots.observation: Its visible preview has no uploader. A subsequent image drop left it unchanged.

screenshots.title: Picture ref → configuration modal
screenshots.observation: Edit image opens a light modal with usage overrides; crop opens another drawer.

screenshots.title: Gallery ref: misleading drop area
screenshots.observation: Dropping on the empty-state message added nothing. The hook is on the button strip above.

screenshots.title: Gallery ref after toolbar-area drop
screenshots.observation: Dropping on the actual upload wrapper and confirming the folder added an image.

screenshots.title: Image variable: empty modal
screenshots.observation: The outer field opens this modal. Its empty canvas supports upload.

screenshots.title: Image variable: populated modal
screenshots.observation: After upload the file input disappears. Only selection and reset remain.

screenshots.title: File variable: empty modal
screenshots.observation: The file uploader reuses an image icon and the image-shaped placeholder.

screenshots.title: Video ref: empty
screenshots.observation: The visible action is Select or create video. There is no direct file drop handler here.

screenshots.title: Image editor
screenshots.observation: Save changes and Save as new copy use distinct mutation/upload paths.

screenshots.title: Image variable at 390px
screenshots.observation: The two-column modal remains; the technical path wraps across the divider.

screenshots.title: Image picker at 390px
screenshots.observation: Nested picker leaves part of the underlying modal visible. Current unsaved image is marked selected.

screenshots.title: Gallery variable
screenshots.observation: Add images/Add videos open pickers. The modal has no direct upload control.

screenshots.title: Images resource: root
screenshots.observation: The shared folder browser has a small native uploader in the toolbar.

screenshots.title: Root image upload: success, empty view
screenshots.observation: Upload succeeded without a manager item; the new image landed in the configured default folder.

screenshots.title: Files resource after upload
screenshots.observation: Native listing upload succeeded. Uploaded local video also has a backing file here.

screenshots.title: Replace shared file
screenshots.observation: This dialog clearly explains replacement everywhere and preserves the URL. Inspected without performing replacement.

screenshots.title: Videos resource: reproduced 500
screenshots.observation: After local video upload the listing failed. Server trace: file association NotLoaded in Video.listing_row/1.

screenshots.title: The uploaded image in its destination
screenshots.observation: The new asset is found under site/default, after navigating away from the root view.

screenshots.title: Gallery field: close-up
screenshots.observation: Upload images, Upload videos, Select images, Select videos. This is a direct element screenshot.

screenshots.title: Image drawer at 390px
screenshots.observation: Measured drawer width 425px, left edge −35px. The title and left control edges are clipped.

screenshots.title: Gallery resource editor
screenshots.observation: Select images and Select videos open library pickers. The collection itself has no uploader or external-file drop target; its drag behavior is for reordering.
